body: I have been using this app for a long time and have been very happy with it. I even paid for the full version. Simply put, the break timer will no longer start running unless the app is open and your screen is unlocked. I used to be able to lock my screen and the break/focus timers would run automatically. Now, if I lock my screen, the break timer will not start, or will start late and throw off the whole focus/break cycle. Changing the settings has not helped, and support has not adresses the issue despite my many follow ups. Now, I have to leave the screen on and the app open if I want it to work, which affects my screen time and battery. It is unfortunate that such a useful app os suffering from such an unnecessary issue. Hopefully it gets fixed soon.
